questions.stem: A book rests on a table. Which pair of forces is a Newton's Third Law pair?

options.text: The weight of the book and the normal reaction from the table
The weight of the book and the book pulling the Earth upward
The weight of the book and the friction on the book

questions.explanation: A Third Law pair must act on different objects, be the same type of force, and be equal and opposite. The weight of the book (Earth pulls book down) pairs with the book pulling the Earth up. Weight and normal reaction are NOT a Third Law pair because they act on the same object.
